description: TEDbus - horaires des lignes du réseau de transport is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération. Timetables of the lines of the transport network operated by the Organizing Authority of Mobility of Dracenie Provence Verdon agglomeration, in GTFS format. Coverage: Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "TEDbus - timetables for transport network lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération. Its keywords include gtfs, mobilite, horaire, ligne, bus, dracenie. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GTFS, GTFS-RT, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
